description: Write the release notes for one release of a public GitHub repository: compares two of its releases (default: the latest release vs the one before) and turns the commits and merged pull requests between them into a Keep a Changelog 2.0.0 section with breaking changes flagged and their migration steps, plus plain-language release notes that thank the contributors. Also returns the merged pull requests with their authors, the repository's releases to pick from, and how each commit was sorted. Deterministic, no AI, no sign-in.

from.description: The earlier release's tag (not included). Default: the release before `to`.

output.description: What the text answer contains: "both" (default), "keep-a-changelog" (a CHANGELOG.md section) or "release-notes" (for a GitHub release or announcement).

repository.description: Public github.com repository: "owner/repo" or its URL. A release URL (…/releases/tag/v1.2.0) or compare URL sets the range too.

to.description: The release's tag to write notes for. Default: the latest release. A branch name gives what's merged since `from`.

name: github_release_notes
title: GitHub release notes generator
